semantics.cordis: cached object service; dependency access traced through Context; no automatic per-call Work/deadline/cancellation/budget
semantics.harness: cached managed service; per-call Work/deadline/cancellation/budget/actual settlement/revocation

measurementScope: fixed warmup; not verified JIT/GC steady state; timed loop includes identical result assertions and checksum accumulation
latencyUnit: microseconds; batchMeanUs is a distribution of 100-call batch means, not individual request tail latency
